title: What If Everything Going Wrong Is Part of Something Going Right? - Women's Lech Lecha Class
blurb: The Life You Planned vs. The Life G-d Has Planned for You: Why Surrendering Control Is the Beginning of Your Deepest Love and Truest Self The life you planned vs. the life G-d has planned for you: Why surrendering control may be the beginning of your greatest freedom, deepest love, and truest self. This class was presented by Rabbi YY Jacobson on 9 Cheshvan, 5787, October 20, 2026. We tell the story of the plumber who entered a cockpit and saved an airplane, the story of Pharaoh’s daughter who stretched out her arm to reach the unreachable, and a captive in Gaza who prays for rain, and it saves his life.

title: The Teachings of The Rebbe – 5737 – Volume 1
Mitteler Rebbe's Padah Beshalom שערי תשובה ד"ה פדה בשלום part 1/6 (פרק א)
blurb: Link to מאמר PDF: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bl4prP_4LXDEjRICVXlZsmYLg-Dd9Dx7/view?usp=sharing In honor of the 200th anniversary of the מיטעלער רבי's חג הגאולה, on י' כסלו תקפ"ז, we are learning the father מאמר of the פדה בשלום מאמרים - the מיטעלער רבי's פדה בשלום, from his ספר שערי תשובה. We begin with the brief story of the arrest and liberation of י' כסלו, as well as the history of this ספר and מאמר. In פרק א, the מיטעלער רבי offers a fascinating insight into the nature of war: is it a display of distance between the two sides, or is it the moment of ultimate closeness? Why is it that to achieve the desired outcome of total victory one must bond with the enemy? Using this analogy to better understand the battle of the two נפשות, the מיטעלער רבי begins פרק ב describing two forms of Davening - a peaceful one, and a warring one.

title: 12th Sefer Torah Hakloli to Be Completed in Buenos Aires
blurb: In an exciting announcement, the committee for the Sefer Torah Hakloli announced that the siyum of the 12th Sefer Torah Hakloli will take place next Sunday, 14 Cheshvan, at La Rural, a major 45,000-square-meter exhibition and convention center in Buenos Aires, Argentina, featuring distinguished guests including Israeli Chief Rabbi Rabbi Kalman Bar .

title: The Rebbe Saw East Flatbush’s Potential 64 Years Ago
blurb: Three newly published letters reveal the Rebbe's remarkable assessment of East Flatbush, his personal initiative to secure funding for its mikvah, and his strong insistence that its construction could not wait.

title: Popular Gemara Shiur Moves to New Crown Heights Location
blurb: A popular weekly Gemara shiur by Rabbi Peretz Kaplan and organized by The New Beis Medrash has moved to a new location, giving yungelait in Crown Heights an opportunity to set aside time from their busy schedules and come together once a week for Torah learning.

title: Chassidus and Academia Collaborate at Stanford University
